quest.title: Warrior's Spirit
quest.description: Some sort of mistake seems to have been made in the voting process for Ayaka's outfit...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Listen to the announcement for the final results of the competition

dialogues.speaker: Akatsuki Saemon Juuzou
dialogues.text: Your skills are superb. I've been thoroughly bested.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was an honor to fight against you.

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen, after an exhilarating battle, the champion for the Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition has been decided! Give it up for... the Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: Tomorrow, we will conduct the final exhibition match... The Traveler and Miss Kamisato versus the Almighty Shogun's chosen envoy, an autonomous humanoid known as the "Maguu Kengou."

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: We'll see you then!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That was a most thrilling match, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Congratulations, Traveler. You've certainly earned your title as the champion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon had no idea that tomorrow's opponent would be the Maguu Kengou... That name sounds similar to that troublesome one we encountered on Yashiori Island. Oh, Paimon doesn't think it'll be an easy fight.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon. The Shogun's chosen envoy may be strong, but tomorrow's match doesn't prohibit the use of Visions. We'll make a formidable team.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: As long as we can track its moves, an opportunity to strike back will present itself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hearing your confidence sure makes Paimon feel better!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I cannot guarantee that we will win, but we must try our best, if just to give the crowd a show they will not forget.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: I can tell you two are already raring to go, but it'd be best to conserve your energy and get some rest tonight.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll also be able to see Ayaka's new outfit when we wake up tomorrow. Ayaka in a Fontaine dress... Oh, Paimon can't wait!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ah, yes. Well...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Huh, Traveler... You too?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Hehe, sounds like there's no way around it, Miss Ayaka. If I wasn't busy tomorrow, I would have loved to come see as well.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ah, I suppose it's settled then. I'll wait for you at the Kamisato Estate tomorrow morning.

choices.text: Do you want me to pick you up in the morning?
It'll definitely be an exciting match.

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, it's Hirotatsu...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Traveler already beat you a few days ago and won the championship. What else do you have to say, hmmmm?

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm not here to cause trouble. I just wanted to apologize. Traveler, I lost to you fair and square a few days ago.

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: Your swordsmanship is excellent. Each strike was precise but not aggressive, which speaks to your character. I ask your forgiveness for misjudging you and offending you with my words and actions.

choices.text: It's okay, it didn't bother me.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: The two of you must be here to pick up Miss Kamisato. She's in the dressing room right now and should be out soon.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: Traveler, before the young lady comes out, I have a bit of a presumptuous request that I hope you can consider.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, what is it?

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: Although the young lady has never mentioned today's exhibition match to us retainers, she has spared a few hours every evening to practice her swordsmanship, despite how busy she is.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: The young lady has always been diligent and conscientious. Although it's just an exhibition match and it won't matter if she loses, I trust that she will do her best to win.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: As a retainer, I do believe in her of course, but... I still hope you can support the young lady in the arena and ensure her safety.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, I will.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: Traveler, I leave the young lady in your hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that must be Ayaka!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh? What's the matter? Why are you two so silent...? Is there something wrong with the outfit?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not at all! Ayaka, you look amazing... You're radiating beauty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, yeah, you look like a spirited young lady who's just stepped off a boat from Fontaine!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Do you think so? I was worried that it might be a little over-the-top... I'm not sure I can pull this off.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: But I'm relieved to hear your thoughts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can't wait to see the look on everyone's faces when they see Ayaka.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Thank you for the compliments, Paimon. Traveler, now that we're ready, let's head to the arena.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: My Lady, Traveler, I wish you all the best in the exhibition match.

choices.text: It's a beautiful outfit and it suits you perfectly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just look at it! It even has the crest of the Kamisato Clan embroidered on it!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Yes, Onodera had someone from the family make it over the last few days. I heard it was based on suggestions that the spectators had written on the ballots.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: The outfit is well-tailored and offers more freedom of movement than I had expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Traveler, Ayaka, we're over here!

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: That was an extraordinary match. I don't know much about swordsmanship, but even I was caught up in the tense atmosphere of the arena. My heart's still pounding even now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Your opponent's moves kept surprising Paimon, but it seems like the two of you were prepared for that.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Traveler, Miss Kamisato, congratulations on winning the exhibition match.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Sara. You came to watch the competition too?

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I was ordered by the Almighty Shogun to observe this competition. You two displayed remarkable swordsmanship and cooperation. Not only did you present the beauty of the sword arts to the audience, I was also able to learn quite a bit myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'm flattered.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: All of you have been busy with various preparations for the competition. Today marks a perfect ending to this Warrior's Spirit event. Your efforts have been recognized by the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: I must return to the Tenshukaku and report on what happened at the exhibition match to the Almighty Shogun. Everyone, please excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: By the way, does everyone have plans now? If not, why don't we go to Uyuu Restaurant for a victory meal?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great idea! We've been so focused on the competition lately that it's been a while since we've had a good meal! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Whew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Ayaka?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh, it's nothing. The effects of winning are only now starting to sink in. Kujou Sara said that she learned a lot from the fight, and so did I.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Although the audience members might not have noticed, there were many moments where I would've been in trouble if it weren't for you by my side drawing away the opponent's attacks.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Without you, it would've been impossible for me to win on my own. It's just as I expected, my swordsmanship is still far from your level.

choices.text: Ayaka, you helped me many times as well.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Really? Hearing you say that makes me want to spar with you all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: To tell you the truth, I've been hoping for an opportunity to spar with you ever since we first met. That wish was half fulfilled today at the exhibition match.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Next time, we'll find a chance to go a few rounds.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Sure. But... until then, make sure you take good care of your sword. If I ever manage to steal it one day, your life will also be in my hands.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe... I've always wanted to say something like that. Did it sound strange?

choices.text: It sounded very much like Miss Orith.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's the hold-up here? What are you talking about?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: We were just talking about having a match to determine which of us is the superior swordfighter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you are so serious when it comes to swordsmanship. But, aren't you friends with the Traveler? Why do you need a match?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: It's precisely because we're friends that we should spar often and learn from each other.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh. Guess that kind of makes sense.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Traveler, keep all I just said a secret?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What did Ayaka say?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Nothing, let's get going.

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: Everyone is looking forward to this exhibition match. Good luck, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Yuu
dialogues.text: In the past, the Archon's Emissary always wore traditional outfits, but today is different.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Are you ready, Traveler?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Good. Let's give it our best. I look forward to fighting beside you.

choices.text: I still need time to prepare.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh, don't worry, there's still some time. Once you've taken care of everything, we can enter the arena together.

dialogues.speaker: Yuu
dialogues.text: Hey look, Miss Kamisato and the Traveler have arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: Although I've seen illustrations of this outfit before, seeing Miss Kamisato wear it truly brings some unique flair.

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: It was worth lining up super early to get front-row seats. I'm really looking forward to today's match!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Ayaka became the center of attention the moment she appeared.

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: Ladies and gentlemen, your attention, please. The Warrior's Spirit exhibition match is about to begin. Please enter the arena in an orderly fashion and take your seats.

dialogues.speaker: Reina
dialogues.text: Miss Kamisato, Traveler, please come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Are you ready, Traveler?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Good. Let's give it our best. I look forward to fighting beside you.

choices.text: I still need time to prepare.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh, don't worry, there's still some time. Once you've taken care of everything, we can enter the arena together.

dialogues.speaker: Sae
dialogues.text: The Kamisato Art versus the Maguu Kengou... and don't forget the champion from the competition! This ticket was so worth it!

dialogues.speaker: Matsumae
dialogues.text: I wonder what Ayaka will look like wearing a Fontaine outfit...

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: My lady's outfit is beautiful. You can tell that she adores it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: I'm relieved to see you both looking so composed before the match.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's about time to head over to the Kamisato Estate and pick up Ayaka! Oh, Paimon's been waiting to finally see Ayaka in her exhibition outfit!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: What an overwhelming presence... Certainly worthy of being the Almighty Shogun's chosen envoy.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But with you by my side, we will emerge victorious. Let's go!
